verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a community contribution path: developers can submit new components by GitHub PR to its source-available registry of triggers and actions, which then ship alongside the pre-built components. The CLI can also deploy an event source from remote code. However, contributions are routed into the vendor's own registry, and there is no documented marketplace or install flow for third-party component packages published outside the vendor. Missing for 10: a documented mechanism to install independently published community components or integrations, and evidence of community-contributed components in use (independent or hands-on corroboration).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor

citations.quote: You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
